packet.prompt:
Read only the supplied manuscript images. Do not search for the text, open a
catalogue or edition, or consult an earlier transcription. Do not identify the
work or author. If prior context has already revealed a proposed identification
or reading, stop and report that exposure instead of calling this a blind reading.

Begin with a brief image-only layout survey. Note orientation, columns, running
titles, rubrics, enlarged initials, underlined text, and interlinear or marginal
glosses when visible. Distinguish observations from tentative interpretations
such as main text with commentary. Do not infer author, work, date, or provenance.
A tight crop may not show the layout; say so rather than guessing.

Use those features to choose a few useful spans: headings or question openings,
then connecting prose, transitions or citation chains. Keep quoted lemmata and
commentary separate. Read enough surrounding prose to make a later source match
checkable; a full transcription is not required. State which areas you selected
and which remain unread. Suggest a wider view or an adjacent crop if needed.

Transcribe those spans, preserving physical lines. Label each line with its
image filename and a line number counted from the top of that image. Keep columns
and marginal additions separate. Note overlapping crops rather than treating
repeated lines as additional text.

Retain abbreviation marks when possible. Put proposed expansions in parentheses,
uncertain readings before a question mark, and unreadable text in [illegible].
Describe visible deletions and additions explicitly. Do not supply missing words
from what would make grammatical or philosophical sense. Leave uncertainty visible.

Return the reading as UTF-8 plain text. Include limitations (cropped lines, damage,
uncertain column order) in that same response. This is an unverified image reading.

text:
UNVERIFIED IMAGE READING - packet-14

Exposure statement: no outside source, catalogue, edition or earlier transcription was consulted. No
identification of work or author is attempted. (Process note: one directory listing of the packet folders was
run to see image filenames; packet.json was not opened.)

LAYOUT SURVEY (observation)
- image-001 = overview of one side (side 1) of a small horizontal piece of paper or thin parchment, about
  16 x 10 cm by the ruler; image-006 = overview of the other side (side 2). Images 002-005 detail side 1,
  007-010 detail side 2.
- The piece is the lower(?) part of an opening or bifolium cut down: a vertical fold/gutter with sewing holes
  runs through it. Side 1: at far left the line-ENDS of a column (cut at the left edge), then the gutter, then
  one full-width column, then at far right the line-BEGINNINGS of another column (cut at the right edge).
  Side 2: at far left line-ends of a column, then one full column, then the gutter, then at far right a
  column of short entries each beginning "De ..." (cut at the right edge).
- Loose, small, strongly cursive hand with heavy abbreviation, grey-black ink, no colour.
- Headings in a much larger, bold, formal display script, in the same ink, each filling one line:
    side 1 middle column: "De co(n)gnatione sp(irit)uali"
    side 1 right column (cut): "De co[cut]" (second letter c, then o/e with a bar; rest lost)
    side 2 main column: "De hijs q(ui) m(at)rimoniu(m) accusa(n)t" (last word read "accusa.."; ending uncertain)
- Small marginal notes beside paragraph openings, in the main hand: "q°" several times (side 1: "q° b°"(?),
  "q°", "so"(?); side 2: "p°"/"q°" four or five times). Paragraphs open with a word read as "Q(ue)rit(ur)" and
  apparently close with "h(ec) Wil'"(?) / "h(oc) Wil" - a recurring two-word tag whose second word begins
  with a W-like or double-loop letter; not resolved.
- Side 2 upper strip is darkened/stained and its first four lines are almost unreadable.
- Tentative interpretation only: short question-and-answer paragraphs grouped under subject headings, with a
  list of further "De ..." headings (a table of titles) in the cut column at the right of side 2.

SPANS SELECTED
Headings (both sides); the paragraph openings under each heading; the "De ..." list. The script is too cursive
for me to give secure connected prose, so body lines are given with many uncertainties. Unread: both cut
left-hand columns (line-ends only), the cut right-hand column of side 1, the stained top of side 2.

--- SIDE 1, MIDDLE COLUMN ---

LIMITATIONS
- Only the three display-script headings and the repeated openings "Q(ue)rit(ur) ..." / "Pono q(uod) ..." are
  read with any confidence; the cursive body is given as a best attempt and should not be used as a quotation
  without checking. The tag I render "h(ec?) Wil(?)" recurs at the ends of paragraphs but I could not resolve it.
- The "De ..." list entries are cut after 3-5 letters; the letters after "De" are guesses from shape.
- The relative order of the columns and of the two sides is not established from the images.
- A higher-resolution image, especially of side 2's stained top and of the cut columns, would help.
